# netbox_notifications (Data Source)

Retrieves all notifications from NetBox. Narrow the result with filter blocks and cap it with limit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_notifications" "example" {
  filter {
    name  = "start"
    value = "example"
  }
  limit = 10
}

output "notifications_ids" {
  value = data.netbox_notifications.example.notifications[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filters that select which items are returned. Each filter is a name/value pair. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 0, which returns all items.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `notifications` (Attributes List) The notifications found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--notifications))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the field to filter by.
- `value` (String) The value of the field to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--notifications"></a>
### Nested Schema for `notifications`

Read-Only:

- `created` (String) When the notifications was created.
- `event_type` (String) The event type of the notifications.
- `id` (Number) The id of the notifications.
- `object` (String) The object of the notifications.
- `object_id` (Number) The object id of the notifications.
- `object_type` (String) The object type of the notifications.
- `read` (String) The read of the notifications.
- `user_id` (Number) The ID of the user associated with the notifications.
